title: Add built‑in body parser middleware (JSON & URL‑encoded)
description: Provides first‑class support for parsing request bodies without external dependencies, improving developer experience and keeping the framework zero‑dependency. Handles JSON and URL‑encoded payloads, enforces configurable size limits, and returns clear 400 errors on malformed input.
testCases: Parse a valid JSON payload and verify req.body contains the object
Parse a valid URL‑encoded payload and verify req.body contains the key/value pairs
Send malformed JSON and expect a 400 response with an error message
Send a payload exceeding the size limit and expect a 413 response
Ensure the middleware does not interfere with routes that do not have a body
acceptance: The framework exposes a `bodyParser(options)` middleware that can be added via `app.use`. When enabled, JSON and URL‑encoded bodies up to the configured limit are parsed into `req.body`. Invalid JSON returns HTTP 400 with a descriptive error, and oversized payloads return HTTP 413. All tests pass and documentation is updated with usage examples.
reason: Body parsing is a core requirement for any API. Adding it natively removes the need for third‑party packages, aligns with the zero‑dependency goal, and reduces boilerplate for developers, directly boosting adoption and production readiness.
